shared_elements: dense low-relief carving covering the whole surface
repeated small motifs in ordered rows/rings
abstracted faces or masks with eyes
justification: Both surfaces are covered edge to edge with dense, abstracted low-relief motifs that include small mask-like faces with staring eyes, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a tall rectangular slab bearing paired vertical columns of block-like glyphs beside a seated human observer, while B is a radially symmetrical toothed disc with concentric rings enclosing a single frontal creature — different organising schemes entirely.
